mira: seeing +120ms p50 across shared-gpu-pool-7 starting ~03:20 UTC. spike correlates with kernel-switch to "kern_v2_int8_fused" on nodes g7a,g7b. baseline was "kern_v1_float16". Any ideas? :eyes:

samir: pulling traces now. can you paste the route and req_id?

mira: route: /v1/generate  tenant: tenant-omega  req_id: a3f2c9... log snippet: "kernel_chosen=kern_v2_int8_fused latency=180ms batch=3 kv_hits=0" — looks like kv cache miss rate spiked

chen: ran quick perf on g7a — seeing high L2 misses on the fused kernel and noticeable warp divergence in attention. dumping profiler summary below.

chen: ```perf_summary
kernel=kern_v2_int8_fused  p50=170ms  p95=420ms
kv_evictions=+23%  avg_kv_size=1.3MB -> 0.9MB
batch_size_dist=1:60% 3:30% 8+:10%
```

ryan: small batches + fused int8 path is a known rough spot — fused kernel optimizations assume larger seq/batch shapes. heuristics may have misrouted interactive traffic.

anita: tenant-omega shows a burst of many 1-utt chat requests at 03:18 with concurrency ~180. classic noisy-neighbor behavior.

samir: correlation: concurrent spike triggered autoscale then our kernel_autoswitch policy picked v2 on pool-7 nodes. autoswitch log: `triggered_by=latency_and_throughput heuristic`

mira: so autoswitch + small batches + int8 fused kernel => bad combo. mitigation idea: disallow autoswitch to fused kernels for shared pools, or require batch-histogram check.

chen: mitigation applied: pinned shared-gpu-pool-7 to kern_v1_float16 with TTL=15m. p50 back to ~28ms within 2 minutes.

anita: long-term action items: 1) add per-tenant soft concurrency caps for shared pools, 2) kernel selection should consult recent batch-size histogram + kv hit rate, 3) KV cache admission control to prevent noisy tenants from evicting hot prefixes.

ryan: also propose a safety rollback: if candidate kernel yields >2x p95 for small-batch cohort, auto-revert within a 5-minute window and mark kernel as 'risky-small-batches'.

mira: filed INF-4721 summarizing: "batch-aware kernel selection + per-tenant eviction throttles to prevent noisy-neighbor regressions". assigning to eng-runtime.

samir: pushing hotfix to disable kernel_autoswitch for shared pools (PR #2345). rolling to pool-7 in 5m.

chen: post-pin metrics: p50=30ms p95=90ms, kv_eviction_rate down ~40%, tenant-omega throughput normalized.

anita: follow-ups: full perf-regression postmortem, add a synthetic e2e test that simulates noisy tenant churn, and add observability panel for batch-size histograms per-pool. on-call review scheduled tomorrow 10:00 UTC.

mira: thanks all. I'll keep the pin for 30m then we can promote to config if stable. :thumbsup:
